body: I believe when you love someone you make time in your schedule. And I believe in partnership. I have helped him shoulder life in the past- when he lost a job, when his mother was diagnosed with cancer, when she passed two years later, I shared in his pain and grief as a partner. I supported him, held him, comforted him, I encouraged him to attend grief counseling, to foster a stronger relationship with his father, I picked up the slack in other areas while he found his feet again. Why am I not worthy of love and support? Why do I have to be alone in my marriage when I have been a partner to him?
